title: You must pay to add more than a single habit!
body: The free version allows you to only track a single habit! The manipulative thing about it was that it allowed me to add around 7 habits, and after tracking them for a few days for free, the app now wouldn’t allow me to track more than one habit and ask me to pay! Save your money, not worth it! There are better apps that can deliver the same value for free or a lot cheaper than this. Aren’t we tired of everything subscription?! The book was awesome, but the app isn’t!
author: AndrewMaxwell11

title: Full of bugs
